Locators are printed journal page numbers (pp.14-23; PDF page = printed - 13). A review by VDZ (Germany) with very few printed numbers: almost every quantitative figure (Figs. 2, 3, 10, 11, 12) is a chart with no value labels, so chart readings went to other-values marked "read from chart". Main file holds 12 technologies, mostly description and state-of-development rows: kiln maximum capacity (12,000-13,000 tpd), oxy-fuel year-available (not before 2030), BCT clinker 30% CO2 reduction, and deployment status for WHR, post-combustion capture, VRM, HPGR, ball mill, ternary cements, sulphoaluminate, belite and CELITEMENT. The thermal efficiency 63%/80% cited in to-get.csv: only "above 80% of the theoretical maximum" is printed (no 63%); it is in other-values because it is not an efficiency in the parameter sense. Whole-plant electricity 100-110 kWh/t cement and the 60-70% comminution share are in other-values (no plant-level archetype). Not extracted: mercury, NOx (SNCR/SCR qualitative Table 1), alternative-fuel biomass shares (Fig. 9 chart).
